desc:
UPDATE 12.0.0 IS NOW IN THE GAME! 🎉

We worked very hard on this update and prepared a lot of new content for you!

WHAT’S NEW?

🧑‍⚕️ Added the School Psychologist role
🤰 Added the Parent role
📱 Improved the game interface
🤬 Added a system for calling parents to the Principal’s Office
And much much more!

Welcome to School 134! 🏫

- The game is based on a real school, making the experience more realistic 😊
- Attend interesting lessons, explore the school and the city, or create your own role-playing stories 😁
- Found a bug or saw someone breaking the rules? Report it to our moderators 😎

And if you want to chat, join our group 💓
